name: gen-L3-02 throw catch finally
code:
log = []
def g():
    try:
        yield "pause"
    except ValueError as e:
        log.append(("caught", type(e).__name__, e.args[0]))
        yield "recovered"
    finally:
        log.append("finally")
it = g()
next(it)
log.append(("throw-return", it.throw(ValueError("boom"))))
try:
    next(it)
except StopIteration:
    log.append("done")
print(log)

log = []
def make_counter(start):
    value = start
    def inc():
        nonlocal value
        value = value + 1
        return value
    def read():
        return value
    return [inc, read]
a = make_counter(0)
b = make_counter(10)
log.append(a[0]())
log.append(a[1]())
log.append(b[1]())
log.append(b[0]())
log.append(a[1]())

name: iterator-L3-01 custom stop
code:
log = []
class Counter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.current = 0
    def __iter__(self):
        return self
    def __next__(self):
        if self.current < 2:
            value = self.current
            self.current = self.current + 1
            return value
        raise StopIteration
it = Counter()
log.append("same" if iter(it) is it else "different")
log.append(next(it))
log.append(next(it))
log.append(next(it, "done"))
print(log)
